entries.definitionCN: 气味，常指难闻的气味

entries.definition: a sweet or pleasant smell
entries.definitionCN: 芬芳；香气

entries.definition: a very bad smell
entries.definitionCN: 恶臭（与 scent 相反）

normalIntro.en: Scent is smell plus a trail: follow the nose, and you follow a path.
normalIntro.cn: scent 是「气味」加「路径」：顺着鼻子走，就是在顺一条线索走。

normal.en: The scent of flowers means their smell carries in the air.
normal.cn: the scent of flowers 表示花香在空中飘散。

normal.en: On the scent of a clue echoes a dog on a trail.
normal.cn: 「on the scent of a clue」借用了狗追气味的画面。

normal.en: To scent danger is to sense it before seeing it.
normal.cn: scent danger 表示还没看见就已察觉危险。

normal.en: Scented soap and scented candles carry the -ed form.
normal.cn: scented soap 与 scented candle 都带 -ed 后缀。

normal.en: Remember the silent c: write scent, not sent, for a smell.
normal.cn: 记住不发音的 c：表示气味要写 scent，不写 sent。

abstract.en: Picture a dog nose to the ground, zigzagging along an invisible line.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狗鼻子贴地，沿一条看不见的线曲折前行。

abstract.en: Imagine a warm bakery smell floating onto the street.
abstract.cn: 想象面包房的热香味飘到街上。

abstract.en: Think of a reporter leaning forward when a hint appears.
abstract.cn: 想象记者一听到苗头就身体前倾。

examples.en: The scent of pine filled the mountain air.
examples.cn: 松树的气味弥漫在山间空气中。

examples.en: The dog lost the scent near the busy road.
examples.cn: 狗在繁忙的公路附近失去了气味踪迹。

examples.en: She scented trouble before the meeting even began.
examples.cn: 会议还没开始她就嗅到了麻烦。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「散特」——香味散得特别远，一路都能闻到；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sentire（感觉、察觉）→ 古法语 sentir（闻、感觉）→ sente（气味踪迹）→ 英语 scent（气味→踪迹→线索→嗅出），核心义「循着气味追踪」。

sensesIntro.en: Scent goes from a smell in the air, to the trail a smell leaves, to a clue in the mind, to the act of sniffing, and finally to a bottle of perfume.
sensesIntro.cn: scent 从空气中的气味，到气味留下的踪迹，到心里的线索，到嗅闻的动作，最后到一瓶香水。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dog with its nose to the ground, following an invisible line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只狗鼻子贴地，沿一条看不见的线前行。

branches.en: A smell in the air is the plain noun sense.
branches.cn: 空气中的气味是最朴素的名词义。

branches.en: A trail is the smell given a path through space.
branches.cn: 踪迹是把气味赋予了空间中的路径。

branches.en: A clue is a trail that only the mind follows.
branches.cn: 线索是只有头脑才会循着走的踪迹。

branches.en: The verb makes the follower act on the trail.
branches.cn: 动词义让追踪者对踪迹做出行动。

branches.en: Perfume is the bottled source of a pleasant smell.
branches.cn: 香水是好闻气味的瓶装来源。

intro.en: Scent carries the Latin root sent- meaning to feel or perceive, seen also in sense, sentence, and sentient.
intro.cn: scent 带着拉丁词根 sent-（感觉、察觉），sense、sentence、sentient 也出自同一词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin sentire means to feel or perceive, and its participle sensus passed into English as sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sentire 意为感觉、察觉，其分词形式 sensus 进入英语成为 sense。

items.example: Sentire lies behind French sentir and English sense.
items.exampleCN: sentire 是法语 sentir 与英语 sense 的来源。

items.example: The root sent- links scent with sense.
items.exampleCN: 词根 sent- 把 scent 与 sense 连在一起。

items.example: Scent keeps the silent c of its shortened form.
items.exampleCN: scent 保留了缩略形式中那个不发音的 c。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms scented.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 scented。

items.example: The suffix -less forms scentless.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -less 构成 scentless。

items.example: Scented describes soap or candles.
items.exampleCN: scented 用于形容肥皂或蜡烛。

items.example: Scentless flowers attract few bees.
items.exampleCN: 无味的花很少引来蜜蜂。

items.example: Sense shares the Latin root with scent.
items.exampleCN: sense 与 scent 共享同一拉丁词根。

definition_zh: 教室；校舍里的上课房间；（喻）刻板教学的场所
definition_en: a room in a school where lessons are taught
core_image: 一排课桌面向讲台，黑板上写着字，窗外是操场
scene: 清晨的校舍安静下来，第一节课的铃声就要响。The children filed into the schoolroom and sat down at their desks.
sceneCN: 这里 schoolroom 是「教室」（第 1 个义项：学校里上课的房间）；句意：孩子们排队走进教室，在自己的课桌前坐下。

derivatives.zh: 由 class（班级）与 room（房间）合成的近义词，义为「教室」
schoolroom 的前半部分，义为「学校」
罕见旧词，指在教室里的学童
罕见构词，义为「设有教室的」

senses.title: A room where lessons are taught
senses.definition: a room inside a school used for lessons
senses.definitionCN: 学校内部用于上课的房间
senses.example: The schoolroom was bright and full of wooden desks.
senses.exampleCN: 教室很明亮，摆满了木课桌。
senses.why: The word simply joins school and room, naming the room in which schooling actually happens.
senses.whyCN: 这个词直接把 school（学校）与 room（房间）合在一起，指 schooling 真正发生的那个房间。

senses.title: A small single-room schoolhouse
senses.definition: a one-room building used as both school and classroom in older times
senses.definitionCN: 旧时既作学校又作教室的单间房屋
senses.example: In the old village, one schoolroom served children of every age.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个旧村庄里，一间校舍供各个年龄的孩子使用。
senses.why: Where schools had only one room, the classroom and the whole building were the same space, so the word named the schoolhouse itself.
senses.whyCN: 学校里只有一间屋子时，教室与整座建筑是同一个空间，于是这个词也指校舍本身。

senses.title: Rigid, book-centred teaching
senses.definition: figurative use for teaching that is formal, obedient, and cut off from real life
senses.definitionCN: 比喻用法，指形式化、要求服从且脱离真实生活的教学
senses.example: Critics said the pupils learned only schoolroom facts, not real skills.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者说学生们只学到课堂式的死知识，而没有真正的技能。
senses.why: The bare room with fixed desks stands for learning that never leaves the walls, so the word can describe stiff, abstract instruction.
senses.whyCN: 固定课桌的空荡教室象征从不走出四壁的学习，因此这个词也能指僵硬、抽象的教学方式。

intro.en: Schoolroom is an English compound of Old English school, borrowed from Latin schola, and room, from Old English rum, meaning space.
intro.cn: schoolroom 是英语复合词：前半 school 借自拉丁语 schola，后半 room 来自古英语 rum（空间）。

items.en: Latin schola means leisure used for study, borrowed from Greek skhole.
items.cn: 拉丁语 schola 意为用于读书的闲暇，借自希腊语 skhole。

items.en: Old English scol names a place of learning.
items.cn: 古英语 scol 指学习之所。

items.en: Old English rum means a space or a spacious place.
items.cn: 古英语 rum 意为空间或宽敞之处。

items.en: English writers join school and room into schoolroom.
items.cn: 中古英语作者把 school 与 room 合成 schoolroom。

items.en: The compound spreads as small village schools become common.
items.cn: 随着小型乡村学校普及，这个复合词开始广泛使用。

items.en: Modern English also uses it figuratively for bookish, formal teaching.
items.cn: 现代英语也用它比喻书本化、形式化的教学。

note.en: Schoolroom belongs to the school word family and sits close to classroom, lecture hall, and the wider word education.
note.cn: schoolroom 属于 school 词族，与 classroom、讲演厅以及更宽泛的「教育」概念相邻。

entries.definition: a room where a class is taught
entries.definitionCN: 进行班级授课的房间，与 schoolroom 近义，更常用于日常与美式英语

entries.definition: a textbook used in schools
entries.definitionCN: 学校里使用的教科书，与 schoolroom 同用 school 前缀

entries.definition: a building used as a school
entries.definitionCN: 用作学校的建筑，侧重整座建筑而非单个房间

entries.definition: a large room for lectures in a college
entries.definitionCN: 大学里讲课用的大房间

entries.definition: a room in a house used for reading and writing
entries.definitionCN: 住宅中用于读书写作的房间

entries.definition: an outdoor area where children play at school
entries.definitionCN: 学校里供孩子玩耍的室外场地，与教室构成学校空间的对照

normalIntro.en: Schoolroom is a plain English compound: school plus room, the room where school happens.
normalIntro.cn: schoolroom 是朴素的英语复合词：school 加 room，就是学校发生的那间屋子。

normal.en: School plus room makes schoolroom, a room for lessons.
normal.cn: school 加 room 构成 schoolroom，即上课的房间。

normal.en: School comes from Latin schola, which first meant leisure for study.
normal.cn: school 来自拉丁语 schola，最初指用于读书的闲暇。

normal.en: In the schoolroom means inside the classroom.
normal.cn: in the schoolroom 表示在教室里面。

normal.en: Classroom is the close synonym and is more common in everyday speech.
normal.cn: classroom 是近义词，在日常口语中更常见。

normal.en: Schoolroom practice often describes old, formal methods of teaching.
normal.cn: schoolroom practice 常用来描述旧式的、形式化的教学方法。

abstract.en: Picture a row of wooden desks facing a blackboard, the sun just reaching the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一排木课桌面向黑板，阳光刚照到地面。

abstract.en: Picture a single whitewashed room with a bell on the roof, the whole village school.
abstract.cn: 想象一间刷白的屋子，屋顶挂着铃铛，那就是整个村庄的校舍。

abstract.en: Picture a room where every answer comes from the textbook and nothing from the street.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋子，所有答案都来自课本，没有一句来自街道。

examples.en: The schoolroom smelled of chalk and rain.
examples.cn: 教室里弥漫着粉笔和雨水的味道。

examples.en: Teachers arranged the schoolroom before the parents arrived.
examples.cn: 老师们在家长到来之前布置好了教室。

examples.en: Her lessons were full of schoolroom order and little laughter.
examples.cn: 她的课堂充满教室式的秩序，却少有笑声。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「思库入目」——学生带着思路走进这个房间，知识就进了眼里；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: school（古英语 scol，借自拉丁语 schola，源自希腊语 skhole「闲暇、讲学」）+ room（古英语 rum「空间」）→ schoolroom（教室里上课的房间），核心义「学校中授课的那间屋子」。

sensesIntro.en: Schoolroom begins as the lesson room in a school, extends to the one-room schoolhouse of small villages, and finally becomes a figure for stiff book learning.
sensesIntro.cn: schoolroom 先指学校里上课的房间，再扩展为小村庄的单间校舍，最后成为刻板书本式学习的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: desks, a blackboard, and a window onto the playground.
core.cn: 核心意象：课桌、黑板，还有一扇望向操场窗户。

branches.en: The lesson room inside a school is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 学校里的上课房间是日常义项。

branches.en: A one-room village school turns the room into the whole building.
branches.cn: 单间乡村学校使这个房间变成了整座建筑。

branches.en: A bare room of fixed desks stands for rigid book learning.
branches.cn: 固定课桌的空荡教室象征刻板的书本学习。

branches.en: Both older schoolhouses and modern classrooms share the room where lessons are taught.
branches.cn: 旧式校舍与现代教室共享「授课之处」这一空间。

branches.en: The physical room and the style of teaching it implies are two sides of one image.
branches.cn: 实体的房间与它所暗示的教学方式是一体两面。

intro.en: Schoolroom is built from two native English pieces, school and room, that also form classroom, schoolbook and schoolhouse.
intro.cn: schoolroom 由 school 与 room 两个英语构词成分组成，它们还能构成 classroom、schoolbook 与 schoolhouse。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola, from Greek skhole, means leisure for study; English school borrows it and keeps the idea of a place of learning.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola 源自希腊语 skhole，意为用于读书的闲暇；英语 school 借入后保留「学习之所」的意思。

items.example: Schola is the Latin source of school.
items.exampleCN: schola 是 school 的拉丁语来源。

items.example: Old English scol names a school.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 scol 指学校。

items.meaning: a place where children are taught
items.example: School forms the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: school 构成这个复合词的前半部分。

items.example: Old English rum means space.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 rum 意为空间。

items.meaning: a part of a building with walls
items.example: Room forms the second half of schoolroom.
items.exampleCN: room 构成 schoolroom 的后半部分。

items.meaning: a group of pupils taught together
items.example: Class plus room gives classroom.
items.exampleCN: class 加 room 构成 classroom。

items.example: Classroom is the everyday synonym.
items.exampleCN: classroom 是日常近义词。

items.meaning: a building used as a school
items.example: Schoolhouse names the whole building.
items.exampleCN: schoolhouse 指整座建筑。

items.example: Schoolbook shares the school prefix.
items.exampleCN: schoolbook 共享 school 前缀。

latinEntries.meaning: a school, study, leisure for learning

definition_zh: 烧焦；烫伤；使干枯；（英口）高速飞驰
definition_en: to burn the surface of something and leave a brown or black mark
core_image: 一块布被热铁烫过，边缘发黄发黑，冒出一点青烟
scene: 煎锅忘了关火，锅底发红，旁边的抹布被烫出一圈褐斑。The iron was left on the shirt and scorched the collar.
sceneCN: 这里 scorch 是「烫焦」（第 1 个义项：把表面烧焦、留下痕迹）；句意：熨斗忘在衬衫上，把领子烫焦了。

derivatives.zh: 动词加词尾 -ing 构成，义为「灼热的；极其炎热的」
过去分词转形容词，义为「烧焦的；被烤干的」
动词加 -er 构成，指「酷热天」，口语也指「严厉斥责」

senses.title: To burn a surface and leave a mark
senses.definition: to burn the outside of something, changing its colour without setting it on fire
senses.definitionCN: 烧到物体表面，使其变色却没有真正起火
senses.example: The pan was too hot and scorched the vegetables.
senses.exampleCN: 锅太热，把蔬菜烧焦了。
senses.why: The old sense of scorch is to dry or crack a surface with heat, and a brown scorch mark is exactly a dried, browned skin.
senses.whyCN: scorch 的旧义就是用热把表面烤干、烤裂，褐色的焦痕正是一层被烤干烤褐的表皮。

senses.title: To dry out plants with fierce heat
senses.definition: to wither grass or crops through intense sun and drought
senses.definitionCN: 因烈日与干旱使草或庄稼枯萎
senses.example: Three weeks of sun scorched the lawn brown.
senses.exampleCN: 三周的日晒把草坪烤成了褐色。
senses.why: Plants that face strong heat lose their moisture and turn brown, so drying with heat grows naturally into burning with heat.
senses.whyCN: 植物遇到强热会失水变褐，因此「用热烤干」自然引申为「用热烧焦」。

senses.title: To travel very fast
senses.definition: informal British use meaning to drive or move at great speed
senses.definitionCN: 英式口语用法，指以极快的速度驾驶或移动
senses.example: They scorched down the motorway at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 他们半夜在高速公路上飞驰。
senses.why: Speed so great that it seems to burn up the road gave speed a second, figurative hint of heat.
senses.whyCN: 快到仿佛把路面都烧起来的程度，让「速度」带上了一层「灼热」的比喻色彩。

intro.en: Scorch is probably from Old Norse skorpna, meaning to shrivel up, and may also be linked to Old French escorchier, meaning to flay or strip off the skin.
intro.cn: scorch 一般认为来自古诺斯语 skorpna（皱缩、干瘪），也可能与古法语 escorchier（剥皮、去皮）有关。

items.en: A reconstructed Germanic root describes shrivelling or drying up.
items.cn: 重构的日耳曼语词根表示皱缩、干瘪。

items.en: Skorpna means to shrivel up or shrink with heat or cold.
items.cn: skorpna 意为因热或冷而皱缩、干瘪。

items.en: Eschorchier means to flay or strip the skin off an animal.
items.cn: eschorchier 意为剥去动物的皮。

items.en: The verb appears in English, and its first record is uncertain.
items.cn: 这个动词在中古英语中进入英语，其首见年代尚不确定。

items.en: Scorch settles on burning a surface, drying plants and, in British speech, speeding along a road.
items.cn: 现代英语让它固定为烧焦表面、烤干植物，以及英式口语中的「飞驰」。

note.en: Scorch belongs with burn, singe and char, and its family includes scorching, scorcher and the phrase scorched earth.
note.cn: scorch 与 burn、singe、char 构成「烧」的义场，其词族包括 scorching、scorcher 与「焦土」这一常用说法。

entries.definition: extremely hot
entries.definitionCN: 极其炎热的；灼热的，由动词加词尾构成

entries.definition: a very hot day, or a severe scolding
entries.definitionCN: 酷热的一天；也指严厉的斥责

entries.definition: a number of points won
entries.definitionCN: 得分；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to burn the edge or surface of something lightly
entries.definitionCN: 轻微燎焦边缘或表面

entries.definition: to burn something until it turns black
entries.definitionCN: 把某物烧黑、烧成炭

entries.definition: to be on fire or to harm with heat
entries.definitionCN: 燃烧；用热伤害

normalIntro.en: Scorch pictures a surface dried and browned by heat, so the word covers ironing, sun, cooking and even fast driving.
normalIntro.cn: scorch 描绘被热烤干、烤褐的表面，因此涵盖熨烫、日晒、烹饪甚至飞驰。

normal.en: Scorching heat names weather that is far too hot.
normal.cn: scorching heat 指热得过分的天气。

normal.en: Scorched earth describes land laid waste so an enemy gains nothing.
normal.cn: scorched earth 指把土地烧光、使敌人一无所获。

normal.en: Related words are singe and char, which cover lighter and deeper burning.
normal.cn: 相关词 singe 与 char，分别指较轻和较深的烧灼。

normal.en: A scorcher is a fiercely hot summer day.
normal.cn: a scorcher 指酷热难当的夏日。

normal.en: In British speech, to scorch along means to drive very fast.
normal.cn: 在英式口语中，scorch along 表示开得飞快。

abstract.en: Picture a white shirt collar with a brown iron-shaped mark.
abstract.cn: 想象一件白衬衫的领子上留下熨斗形状的褐色痕迹。

abstract.en: Picture a summer lawn turning pale and crisp after weeks without rain.
abstract.cn: 想象几周无雨之后，夏日草坪变得苍白而干硬。

abstract.en: Picture a car that leaves a haze of heat as it races down the road.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆车在公路上飞驰，身后留下一道热浪。

examples.en: The dry summer scorched the fields around the village.
examples.cn: 干燥的夏天把村子周围的田地烤干了。

examples.en: He scorched the toast and opened the window.
examples.cn: 他把吐司烤焦了，只好打开窗户。

examples.en: Weeks of scorching weather emptied the streets at noon.
examples.cn: 持续数周的酷热让正午的街道空无一人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「死靠吃」——火太猛，食物死命靠着吃都会烧焦；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为来自古诺斯语 skorpna（皱缩、干瘪），词源细节存疑；也可能与古法语 escorchier（剥皮）有关 → 中古英语 scorchen（烤焦，首见年代不确定）→ 英语 scorch，核心义「用热把表面烤干烤焦」。

sensesIntro.en: Scorch starts from a surface dried and browned by heat, spreads to plants withered by sun, and ends with the informal idea of burning along a road at speed.
sensesIntro.cn: scorch 从被热烤干烤褐的表面出发，扩展到被烈日烤枯的植物，最后落到口语里「一路飞驰」的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: brown, smoking edges on fabric touched by a hot iron.
core.cn: 核心意象：被热熨斗碰过的布料边缘发褐冒烟。

branches.en: Burning a surface until it browns is the core sense.
branches.cn: 把表面烧到发褐是核心义项。

branches.en: Sun and drought extend the heat from a mark to whole plants.
branches.cn: 烈日与干旱把热量从焦痕扩展到整株植物。

branches.en: Speed fast enough to seem to burn the road is the informal sense.
branches.cn: 快到仿佛烧着路面，是口语义项。

branches.en: A browned lawn and a browned collar share the same drying heat.
branches.cn: 烤褐的草坪与烫褐的衣领共享同一种烤干的热。

branches.en: Both senses carry intensity: a burning touch and a burning pace.
branches.cn: 两个义项都带有强烈的程度：烫人的触碰与灼人的速度。

intro.en: Scorch is a verb of uncertain northern origin, and its English family grows with the suffixes -ing and -er.
intro.cn: scorch 是来源不确定的北方动词，其英语词族通过词尾 -ing 与 -er 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The word has no secure Latin source; it is generally traced to Old Norse skorpna, so the Latin parallels here are only for comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有确凿的拉丁语来源，一般认为出自古诺斯语 skorpna；下面列出的拉丁词仅供对照。

items.example: Scorch takes the verb sense.
items.exampleCN: scorch 承担动词义。

items.meaningCN: 表示过去或形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ed gives scorched and scorched earth.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 scorched 与 scorched earth。

items.example: Scorched fields show the drought.
items.exampleCN: scorched fields 显示出干旱。

items.meaning: forming a present participle or adjective
items.meaningCN: 构成现在分词或形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing gives scorching.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 scorching。

items.example: Scorching heat closes the market early.
items.exampleCN: scorching heat 让市场提前关门。

items.meaning: a person or thing that does something
items.example: The suffix -er gives scorcher.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 构成 scorcher。

items.example: Scorcher names a fiercely hot day.
items.exampleCN: scorcher 指酷热的一天。

items.example: Singe is the lighter cousin of scorch.
items.exampleCN: singe 是 scorch 程度更轻的近亲。

items.example: Char goes deeper than scorch.
items.exampleCN: char 比 scorch 烧得更深。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 烧尽（仅供对照，并非 scorch 的来源）
